title: Tight Single-Trail Distinguisher Bounds for Sparx-64/128
summary: Five steps exclude single-trail differential and linear distinguishers for Sparx-64/128, but the tight minimum step count for each type remains unknown.

formal_statement.body: For $\mathrm{Sparx}\text{-}64/128$, the Long Trail argument proves that five steps are sufficient to exclude single-trail differential and linear distinguishers, but this five-step bound is not expected to be tight. Determine tight bounds for both types of single-trail distinguisher, including the minimum number of steps sufficient to exclude each type.

scope.domain: Cryptanalysis of the Sparx-64/128 block cipher against single-trail differential and linear distinguishers.
parameters: Number of steps, determining the exclusion threshold for each distinguisher type
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine tight bounds, including the minimum sufficient number of steps, for excluding each type of single-trail distinguisher.

citations.label: Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX

progress.summary: The source proves a five-step Long Trail bound for excluding both single-trail differential and linear distinguishers and states that this bound is not expected to be tight. Tighter minimum step thresholds remain unresolved.
citation_labels: Daniel Dinu et al., Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX
